The professor explained graph theory with very clear examples and solved all doubts.
The projector in room 302 flickers constantly and makes it difficult to read slides.
The midterm exam schedule gave us adequate preparation days between tough subjects.
Accounts counter is severely understaffed and students wait for hours in long queues.
The chemistry lab equipment is modern and the lab assistant is very supportive.
Semester results were delayed by three weeks without any notification from the office.
Lectures are very dull and the teacher merely reads bullets off outdated presentations.
New high-speed Wi-Fi in the campus library has made online research much easier.
The examination committee announced the supplementary exam guidelines yesterday.
The faculty member was not helpful during the project review and gave arbitrary marks.
College administration processed my bonafide certificate request on the same afternoon.
The washrooms in the engineering building are dirty and frequently lack running water.
The university guest lecture on cybersecurity will be held this Friday at two PM.
Evaluation of our internal test sheets was unfair and marks were deducted without reason.
The campus cafeteria food is tasty, hygienic, and very reasonably priced.
The registrar refused to verify my document and asked me to return tomorrow.
The classroom desks are broken and uncomfortable for long three-hour lecture blocks.
The mathematics instructor is always punctual and teaches complex proofs with patience.
Midterm question paper was well balanced and aligned with what was covered in class.
Today's morning lecture focused on solving exercises from chapter three.
